leadStory.headline: FDA Clarifies Cell and Gene Therapy Quality Standards for Manufacturers
leadStory.standfirst: The FDA's final guidance on comprehensive CGT quality implementation establishes binding standards for cellular and gene therapy development, directly affecting manufacturing protocols and regulatory pathways for European sponsors seeking US market access.
leadStory.body: This guidance consolidates FDA expectations across CMC, potency, and manufacturing controls for CGT products, eliminating ambiguity that has delayed programme timelines. For European pharma and CROs, alignment with these standards now becomes mandatory for parallel EMA submissions, requiring early investment in quality-by-design frameworks. The implication: regulatory strategy must front-load CGT quality documentation in IND applications, reducing cycle time and bridging the EMA-FDA expectations gap that has historically created rework cycles.
